I think from the way he is attacking it that my problem will be solved infinitely more precisely & thoroughly than his & I think it exceedingly unlikely that he will have found out all that I have done. I daresay however he’ll find out some of what I miss. His work appears to be much more one of theoretical dynamics. I’m delighted at this.
